arguments.explanation: Flags a random sample of about 1% of transactions for manual review. The sample is not tied to any transaction attribute, so it will differ each time the rule is evaluated.
assumptions: 'Random 1%' means each transaction has an independent 1-in-100 chance of being flagged, so the share is approximately 1% rather than an exact count.
The sample is not reproducible: re-running the rule selects a different set of transactions.
The rule does not use any transaction attribute or fraud label.
